edits.old: None in this story. The contract serves the two reads that the gateway-bff composite route composes for SCR-46 Agent monitor, states Shadow; live; paused, and that route and that screen belong to the monitor story and to RWB-PLT-N001-CON. The three states change no row of the two responses (AC11 of RWB-P10-E8005-APP), and the contract fixes no screen field, order or masking rule. The empty, loading, error and no access states of SCR-46 are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-2906): Screen Specifications v1 does not define them, and this contract adds none.
